Stock can go negative without warning.

A POS sale from the Front Counter register (no stock there) and an adjustment at the Default location left on-hand at −1 and −2, with negative stock value (LKR −37,000). Fix: block or warn on issues that take a location below zero, unless the company allows negative stock.
Product save reports an error but still creates the product.

Saving a stocked product with opening quantity but no opening location shows "Pick a location for opening stock", yet the product is created with quantity 0. Fix: validate before insert and roll back on error.
Stock transfer form has no From and To location fields.

/inventory/transfers/new only has Date, Reason, product lines and Notes, so a transfer cannot say where stock moves from or to. The first line is also prefilled with A4 Copy Paper, qty 1. Fix: add required From/To location selects and start with empty lines.
ADJ-20261126-0001 (one line, posted) shows LINES 0 in the adjustments list. Fix: count lines in the list query.

Rental products (Banquet Chair, Marquee Tent and their fleet variants) appear as sellable tiles in the POS grid at their hire price. Fix: exclude rental-type products from POS, or route them to a hire flow.
Purchase bill asks for hire dates when it contains a rental product.
Buying rental fleet stock on a purchase bill requires hire-from/to dates, which do not apply to a purchase. Fix: only ask for hire dates on sales documents.
Sales order detail hides the hire details.
Hire from/to, event date, venue and guest count entered on the order form are not shown on the order detail page (only on Dispatch / returns). Fix: show a Hire block under the header on hire orders.
